# Round 3: power-ranking accuracy (generated by research/round3_rankings.py)

Ranking published before each week (weeks 2-17). **Remaining-season accuracy** = share of all remaining regular-season games won by the higher-ranked team (home field ignored, so every method is scored the same way). **Next week** = that week only. **Correlation** = rank correlation with each team's remaining-season average margin. **Stability** = average places moved per week.

| Method | Remaining-season accuracy, dev | holdout | 2026 (wks 2-8) | Next-week accuracy, dev | holdout | Correlation, dev | holdout | Stability (places/wk), holdout | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| nfelo QB-adjusted Elo | 62.3% | 63.2% | 62.9% | 63.9% | 64.9% | 0.506 | 0.495 | 2.24 | not better on both |
| Model power (current, incl. QB) | 63.2% | 62.7% | 62.6% | 64.6% | 66.0% | 0.526 | 0.514 | 2.08 | current method |
| Model power without QB adjustment | 63.4% | 62.7% | 61.6% | 64.9% | 66.1% | 0.525 | 0.515 | 1.85 | not better on both |

| Model power, 3-week average | 62.9% | 62.4% | 60.9% | 65.2% | 66.3% | 0.518 | 0.498 | 1.25 | not better on both |

## Luck: which record best predicts the rest of the season?

For each team and each week 4-14: season-to-date win %, Pythagorean win % (from points scored/allowed), and the model's expected win % (average pre-game win probability in games played). Error = RMSE against the team's remaining-season win %.

| Predictor | RMSE dev | RMSE holdout | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Actual win % so far | 0.2637 | 0.2596 | baseline |
| Pythagorean win % (points for/against) | 0.2237 | 0.2254 | **better than record on both** |
| Model expected win % (pre-game probabilities) | 0.2158 | 0.2200 | **better than record on both** |

## Trend: last 4 weeks vs season-long

Does a team's rating change over the last 4 weeks predict how it does over the rest of the season, beyond its current rating? Slope of remaining-season margin (above what the current rating expects) on the 4-week trend. A positive slope would mean "hot" teams keep beating expectations.

| Period | Slope (pts of future margin per pt of trend) | Correlation |
|---|---|---|
| Development | -0.067 | -0.026 |
| Holdout | -0.199 | -0.080 |
